hooks.command: file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$file_path" == *sql/recommendations/*.sql ]]; then echo '🔍 Validating SQL syntax...' && bq query --dry_run --use_legacy_sql=false < "$file_path" 2>&1 | head -3 && echo '✅ SQL syntax valid' || (echo '❌ SQL syntax error'; exit 2); fi

file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$file_path" == *.py ]]; then echo '🔧 Formatting Python...' && ruff format "$file_path" 2>&1 && ruff check --fix "$file_path" 2>&1 | head -5 && echo '✅ Python formatted'; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$cmd" == *'--force'* ]] && [[ "$cmd" == *'push'* ]]; then echo '⚠️ BLOCKED: Force push detected. Use regular push instead.' && exit 1; fi
